artifact.view: Five pages; default/historical/empty scopes;20directed routes;1440x900 plus sampled narrow Vintage view

categories.label: Source authority and confidence
categories.assessment: All49 numeric components trace to the declared synthetic fixture, source definitions and matching installed SQL. No real-bank claims are made.

categories.label: SQL/value accuracy
categories.assessment: All30 headline KPIs, ten charts, eight tables/matrices and the contract attribute panel reconcile to independently reconstructed inputs. Browser cases cover default, filtered historical and empty scopes; this is not every possible filter combination.

categories.label: Within-chart agreement
categories.assessment: Ten charts were inspected on desktop; source values, percent/RUB units, legends and final rendered marks agree. Animation intermediates were excluded from final assessment.

categories.label: Complete source details
categories.reason: No interactive source-detail surface is part of this native FineVIS report; SQL/lineage is verified through the delivered project.

categories.label: Cross-artifact consistency
categories.assessment: Ten named component relationships reconcile, including stock/flow, exposure/buckets, cohort denominators and contract ledgers.

categories.label: Data-quality controls
categories.assessment: Eligibility, dated outcomes/allocations, closed/write-off states, zero versus NULL and cohort maturity were checked. Edge dates and contracts are sampled rather than exhaustive.

categories.label: Conclusion support
categories.reason: The dashboard makes descriptive measurements and definitions, without causal or prescriptive business conclusions.

categories.label: Analytical clarity
categories.assessment: Five page purposes and nearby definitions are coherent: funded flow versus submission cohort, all-channel plans, full-loan exposure, cohort maturity and contract-specific scope remain explicit.

categories.label: Visual and interaction consistency
categories.assessment: All five desktop pages, twenty directions, filters, Apply and pagers passed. One sampled narrow view makes the dense Vintage matrix too small to read; desktop viewing is the supported practical use.

categories.label: Dashboard usefulness and completeness
categories.assessment: All five requested analytical jobs and their major sections are present and usable in the checked desktop scenarios.
